scope: Opt-in INVLPG WP profile and mutable diagnostic translation-session integration.
coverage: WP=0 and WP=1 canonical invalidation start with a resident matching cache entry
After PTE remap, the matching probe returns stale Hit before INVLPG; after effect consumption it walks to the new mapping, then hits
Noncanonical retired NOP preserves the resident entry
Ring1, Ring2 and Ring3 receive exact #GP(0); LOCK receives exact #UD
Instruction fetch page fault preserves CPU and cache

Matching AccessKind::Fetch entry at INVLPG RIP is warmed; after its PTE is removed, execute returns exact fetch #PF with zero retirement and unchanged CPU, while probing that same Fetch key still returns the stale Hit
Unsupported instruction and CR0/CR3/CR4 mismatch preserve cache
Page-table entries are unchanged across pure fetch and effect consumption
The existing WP=1-only CPU entry rejects WP=0 before fetch
Unsupported CR0 values are rejected before fetch
limits: One-entry diagnostic cache, not a production TLB
No tracked A/D caching, reset, other control-register transitions, PCID/global, JIT, DMA or SMP
independent_review: clean on final gpt-6.1-sol/high review; initial finding fixed and rechecked
